t: Fairbanks borough mayor proposes temporary pause on large data center land use permits
b: Mayor Grier Hopkins proposed a temporary moratorium on the borough granting land use permits for large data centers. Length and next steps were not given in the report; the Assembly has not voted on it.
iw: A local permit pause would block new large projects if adopted.

t: Kenai borough seeks role in federal review of Cook Inlet subsea data center
b: The borough filed a motion to intervene in FERC's review of DeepGreen's preliminary permit for a 100-megawatt underwater data center in Cook Inlet, asking for adequate public notice and a chance to comment.
iw: Local intervention adds scrutiny and delay to an early-stage project.

t: Fairbanks borough assembly backs state data center moratorium as 2027 priority
b: The Assembly voted 6-1 to adopt 2027 legislative priorities, including a moratorium on commercial data centers on municipal or state-owned land until community-concern standards exist. It asks the Legislature to act when it convenes in January.
iw: Only a request to the state so far, but signals opposition.

t: Anchorage adopts first zoning rules for data centers
b: The Assembly passed AO 2026-27 by 10-2. Data centers are limited to commercial and industrial zones, need a conditional use permit and public review, and must show utility electric, water and wastewater capacity. Developers may fund upgrades.
iw: New permit, setback and capacity-proof requirements add cost and delay.
